$Comment: A Normal weekly goblin cull. Target Goblin, under the Bounty_Kill parent's CONTAINS, counts every goblin role, the Deepworks' and the Coffer goblins included; Targets adds Dungeon_Feastmaster_Scrapper, the Goblin Scrappers the Feastmaster calls in during its fight, whose id carries no Goblin. A step counts its Target and every Targets entry under the one MatchMode.
